summary: Solana web3.js SDK bundle — keyword co-occurrence in minified output, no traced harm
details: Package is the Solana Labs JavaScript SDK for interacting with the Solana blockchain. Pattern matches fired on the minified CJS/ESM bundles (lib/index.cjs.js, lib/index.esm.js) for keyword co-occurrence of require('child_process'), fetch/POST, and the strings 'curl' / 'ping' within the same single-line bundle. Semantic verification of these patterns within a minified rollup is not conclusive; child_process and HTTP primitives in an SDK bundle are consistent with the documented Solana RPC client surface and tooling helpers, and the 'curl'/'ping' substrings commonly appear in error messages or doc strings rather than as exec arguments. No hardcoded attacker-controlled C2 endpoint, browser-credential enumeration, wallet-extension lookup, seed-phrase scanner, or credential-path read is cited in the available evidence. Routing to human review so a reviewer can confirm the bundle's network destinations resolve to documented Solana RPC infrastructure and that child_process usage is not reachable at install/import time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
